name: Davis Big Summer 2026
information:
## Davis' Summer competition makes a return!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk1ODQzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--755e0e2f757fb83f78f14bc546f1c91ad7bcd42a/bigsummer.png)

- All attendees under the age of 18 are required to be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
- Competition attendees may **appear on livestream and media**.
- If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes.
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

**This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and sponsored by [GAN Cube](https://www.gancube.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/)**
